title: mise-task-schema
description: Config file for included mise tasks (https://mise.jdx.dev/tasks/task-configuration.html)

task.description: a task: a script, a list of scripts and task references, or a table

oneOf.description: script to run
scripts or task references to run

extends.description: name of the task template to extend

oneOf.description: script to run

args.description: arguments to pass to the task

env.description: environment variables to set for the task

oneOf.description: alias for this task
alias for this task

confirm.description: prompt to answer before this task's own command runs, after its dependencies

oneOf.description: confirmation message before running this task
confirmation message before running this task with optional default value and custom answer labels

message.description: confirmation message before running this task

yes.description: custom label for the affirmative answer

no.description: custom label for the negative answer

depends.description: tasks that must finish before this task runs

oneOf.description: task with args to run before this task
task with args to run before this task

daemons.description: [experimental] project daemons that must be running and ready before this task runs

oneOf.description: true requires every daemon declared in [daemons]
name of a daemon declared in [daemons]
names of daemons declared in [daemons]

depends_post.description: tasks to run after this task finishes

oneOf.description: task with args to run after this task
task with args to run after this task

wait_for.description: tasks to wait for if they are already scheduled, without adding them to the run

oneOf.description: task with args to wait for completion first
task with args to wait for completion first

dir.description: directory to run script in, default is the project's base directory

tools.description: tools to install/activate before running this task

outputs.description: files or directories this task creates; compared with `sources` to skip the task when it is up to date

oneOf.description: files created by this task (entries starting with `!` are excluded; use `\!` to escape a literal `!` prefix)

items.description: glob pattern or path to files created by this task (entries starting with `!` are excluded)

oneOf.description: glob pattern or path to files created by this task (entries starting with `!` are excluded)

auto.description: automatically touch an internal tracked file instead of specifying outputs; `false` is the same as leaving `outputs` unset

cache.description: experimental local artifact cache for declared task outputs

enabled.description: store and restore task outputs from the local mise cache

audit.description: report project files read or written outside declared cache sources and outputs

env.description: ambient environment variable names whose values affect the cache key

command_inputs.description: commands whose stdout and stderr affect the cache key

rust_cache.description: deprecated no-op; use mbx for Rust action caching instead: https://mr-boxington.jdx.dev/getting-started

output.description: output style for this task (prefix, interleave, keep-order, replacing, timed, quiet, silent). Independent of the quiet/silent verbosity fields.

quiet.description: do not display mise information for this task

silent.description: suppress all output for this task

interactive.description: mark task as interactive, acquiring exclusive terminal access while allowing other non-interactive tasks to run in parallel

raw_args.description: skip mise's argument parsing for this task — all arguments (including --help/-h) are forwarded verbatim to the underlying command. Use for tasks that proxy a tool with its own argument parser.

sources.description: files this task reads; mise skips the task when none changed since its outputs were written

oneOf.description: files that this task depends on (entries starting with `!` are excluded; use `\!` to escape a literal `!` prefix)

items.description: glob pattern or path to files that this task depends on (entries starting with `!` are excluded)

oneOf.description: glob pattern or path to files that this task depends on (entries starting with `!` are excluded)

shell.description: specify a shell command to run the script with

usage.description: Specify usage (https://usage.jdx.dev/) specs for the task

skip_if.description: shell command checked before the task runs; if it exits 0, the task is skipped and counts as successful

deny_all.description: block reads, writes, network, and env vars

allow_net.description: allow network to specific hosts; not supported yet, so Linux and macOS reject it

pass_through_env.description: experimental ambient env vars preserved under environment denial without affecting the task cache key

secrets.description: [experimental] Secret keys this task receives when it starts, e.g. ["DEPLOY_KEY"]. Dependencies do not inherit them. See `mise secrets ls`.

version.description: version of the tool to install
